# PEN-3808 — name the collision-skip fail-open asymmetry

PR: [#2238](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/2238)

## Files

- `src/server/job-manifest.ts`
- `src/server/k8s-client.ts`

## What changed

Comment-only; no runtime behaviour changes.

`job-manifest.ts` gains a comment on the inherited-secret-volume loop in
`buildJobManifest` documenting an asymmetry with PEN-3705. An inherited Secret
volume whose mount path collides with the operator-chosen `workspaceMountPath`
throws. One that collides with any other already-claimed path — the
adapter-hardcoded `/tmp/prompt` and `/runtime-cache` mounts, or an earlier
inherited volume at the same path — is skipped by a silent `continue`, dropping
the volume. The comment contrasts this with PEN-3705, which made an absent
Secret fail closed by carrying `optional` through instead of forcing `true`, and
notes that the skip does not reproduce PEN-3705's fleet-shared PVC substitution:
a colliding path stays claimed by whatever it collided with, so the failure is a
missing credential (or, for the two `emptyDir` paths, a per-pod writable path).
It records the skip as a deliberate trade (a collision requires a configured
mount, whereas a missing Secret is ordinary platform drift that must not wedge
every run) and warns that changing it is a behaviour change with its own blast
radius, not a comment fix.

`k8s-client.ts` corrects a path in the `SelfPodSecretVolume.optional` doc
comment: `authbot-mcp-consumer-service-keys` mounts at `/var/run/authbot`, not
`/run/authbot`. The argument it supports is unchanged — either path is outside
the shared PVC.
